categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Longway Electronic Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of data center cabinets and comprehensive cabling products. Its main product lines include server cabinets, cold and hot aisle containment systems, micro-modules, T-block racks, data cables, wiring cabinets, and customized cabinets for specific industries such as new energy storage. The company also provides integrated solutions for data center infrastructure and intelligent building cabling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as cabinet system sealing, modular cabinet system design, composite stamping technology for cabinet components, and structural reinforcement techniques. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including composite stamping to reduce material waste, robotic welding with no-trace welding technology, and automated electrophoretic and powder electrostatic coating for superior surface quality. Production is highly customized and modular, enabling rapid design and delivery tailored to client needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading internet and telecommunications companies such as Tencent, NetEase, ZTE, and Vertiv Technologies. The products serve primarily the data center industry, including large and medium-sized data centers, intelligent buildings, and emerging sectors like new energy storage. The company’s solutions are applied in domestic data centers and exported to Europe, North America, Australia, Africa, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Suzhou and Ningbo. It has established subsidiaries and sales networks in major overseas markets including the United States, Europe (Germany, UK), Australia, and other regions, supporting a global sales and service footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Longway Electronic Machinery is positioned upstream in the data center industry supply chain, manufacturing critical infrastructure components such as server cabinets and cabling systems. It supplies these foundational products to data center operators and service providers who then deploy IT equipment and offer cloud and internet services downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in energy-efficient and modular data center infrastructure, including development of liquid cooling solutions, intelligent power distribution cabinets, and high-security cabinets for specialized industries. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance product performance, reduce energy consumption, and accelerate delivery through modular design. Collaborations with academic and industry partners are planned to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized data center cabinets, comprehensive cabling products, and related components. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with revenues recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong competitive position in the data center cabinet manufacturing sector, recognized for its advanced sealing and modular technologies. It competes with other domestic and international data center infrastructure providers, leveraging its customization capabilities, energy-saving features, and established relationships with top-tier clients to maintain market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.29 billion, a 40.64% increase over the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 91.2 million, up 47.31%. Total assets reached RMB 1.81 billion, growing 21.16% year-over-year. The company has demonstrated strong growth driven by expanding sales volumes, product innovation, and international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Longway Electronic Machinery differentiates itself through its proprietary cabinet sealing and modular system technologies that enhance cooling efficiency and reduce data center energy consumption. Its products offer superior structural strength, seismic resistance, and corrosion resistance, ensuring stable and secure operation of IT equipment. The company’s rapid customization and delivery capabilities, combined with a focus on green, low-carbon solutions, provide significant cost savings and performance benefits to customers.
